rows.visualText: Host on camera, medium shot, warm key light. Logo bug bottom-right.
rows.audioText: Hey — welcome back. If you have been following the channel, you know we have been building this out in public. Today I want to show you exactly how it works.

rows.visualText: Cut to a screen recording: the editor open, cursor moving between the two columns.
rows.audioText: On the left, what the viewer sees. On the right, exactly what gets said — word for word, ready for the teleprompter. (This sentence shows off a link, too.)

comments.author: Priya (reviewer)
comments.body: Can we soften this a little? Maybe just word for word without the extra emphasis.
